notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello,

I have been making things in 3D for a long time (9 years), So when I designed the control system, it was very biased from my perspective, which led to difficult controls and a steep learning curve. So after playtesting and looking at demo data I changed some things, and hopefully this will make it better for new players(everyone).

The changes-

 You can not place things inside other things or outside of the room.
 First few pre-builds at the start are unmovable. 
 You will always move in the direction you asked for and not in the direction compare to where your looking at. Hard to explain sorry, just try moving around in the game.
 When you press 1,2,3 not in rotation mode you can move the object in a straight lines. 
 axis lines have colors.
 More stable physics - Friction was too low and bounciness was too high on most of the objects so I fixed that. 
 The THING that happnes when you make the marble fall into the final bucket at 2nd level is now on 3rd level.
 Added japanese language.
 Added sound effects to more objects.
 more small things but I forgot.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460366/4198d93c154c068645f923a69ae99ca96979ad04.png
The old Advance system still exist and you can change into that from the settings. 

if you have any more suggestions or want to play beta builds just send me a DM on twitter or discord - AyushR#3294


Co-op?

Im planning to add co-op but that means rewriting the whole game and im just a solo dev, so for now only testing waters. 
How much will you like to see a co-op in this game? let me know because right now its 50/50.

Thanks for reading, and if you got any feedback please let me know,
Ayush

notes.title: Why am I making this game?
notes.content:
Hello I am Ayush, I would like to share why I'm making this game.

Little backstory 

When I was a kid, I didn’t have any technology like mobile phones or computers, so I used to make marble runs with books and toys.

Present time- One day messing around in unreal engine I made a marble run and it reminded me of the good old days. So now I decided to make it into an actual game for other people to enjoy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460366/3477c33c750ea0e9f547eca799207656d6485cbb.png

When I started making this game, I wanted a game that was relaxing to play, but also had a sense of creativity and accomplishment. Most of the games I've played are a bit difficult, and I play Dark Souls as a relaxing game, but I wanted a more creative game.

That’s what inspired me to start working on this game, and honestly, while making it I’ve probably played it in its bare-bones stage for about 20 hours because it’s just so fun. I even listened to an entire light novel series while playing it, it’s kinda perfect for multitasking, lol.

But this has also led to some pretty complicated control systems, though it works well in the long run, so I hope you guys can stick with it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460366/423fdbdd4e1eedcc8c7697a6f3a47e673966e655.png

What about you?

I got like 60 wishlists which means 60 other people are interested in this game. I wanna know why you guys think it's interesting and what you expect from the final product?


Thanks for reading.
